entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah. I'm calling about the VeloBand GPS Tracker I recently bought. I'm looking to see what my options are for a return.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the band or more of a preference issue?

It works perfectly fine, technically. It's just not what I was expecting, and I don't think I'll use it. I know I'm probably past the initial return period, but I was hoping we could work something out, maybe a store credit or a discount on a future purchase?
I understand completely. Let me just pull up your order details. Can you please confirm the email address on the account for me?
Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see your order right here. It looks like the VeloBand was delivered on December 30th, just 8 days ago.
Right, so I figured it might be too late. Is there anything at all you can do?
Actually, you have nothing to worry about. Our return policy allows for returns up to 90 days after delivery. You are well within that window for a full refund.
Oh! Really? Ninety days? I was preparing for a whole negotiation. That's fantastic news. So, a full refund is no problem?

No problem at all. I have just initiated that return in our system. I'm sending an email to you right now that contains a prepaid shipping label and instructions on how to send the VeloBand back to us. Once our warehouse receives it, your refund will be processed.
Wow, that was much easier than I expected. Thank you so much, Sarah. I really appreciate the help.
You're very welcome! Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Nope, that was it. Thanks again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
